extraction.Name: Elizabeth Stirk-nes-Cottier
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. recorded 2-1-21 by state Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and deeded to State Bank of Scenic
extraction.Buyer: On Dec. 12, 1922, Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, S.D. NE¼ 32-37-39 for $2650.00; On Feb. 14, 1924, Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. the NE¼ 32-37-39 for $800.00; On Jan. 2, 1925, Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. the NE¼ 32-37-39 for $3236.00; NE¼ 32-37-39 deeded to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. for consideration Mar. 5, 1926, by Elizabeth Stirk and George Stirk, her husband
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 1, 1918. Taken from the records at the County Seat on Jan. 2, 1925, by Elizabeth Stirk and George Stirk, her husband. Land described as NE¼ 32-37-39. Also known as Elizabeth Stirk formerly Cottier. Multiple mortgages and eventual deed to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak.
